blue digital logo visible on right side in photo 1

machine resting on wooden pallet or surface

photo of the page counter or meter reading

response.reason: The Sharp AR-M207 is clearly identifiable from the model plate in all three photos, so it can be priced at its worst case as an untested, wrapped unit with unverified claims.
